# DryingFilmCrackModeling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A theoretical framework that models the stress-driven fragmentation of thin films into hierarchical crack networks, capturing the temporal and spatial evolution of fractures. Offers a natural analogy for distributed, emergent network formation that can inspire robust, decentralized neuromorphic interconnect designs in iNEST.
